public_sources.semantic_binding: Task.cancel requests cancellation but does not guarantee the coroutine has stopped; cancellation may be suppressed, so an abort request alone cannot safely authorize reuse against possible late completion.
resourceVersion represents persisted object version and conditional updates reject stale client state; this supports a version/fence check before accepting a late effect.

mechanism_reduction: Treat cancellation as advisory for physical execution and make the role-local abort-generation tombstone authoritative for acceptance. Persist the tombstone and exactly-once reservation release before slot reuse; any later terminal carrying the aborted generation is stale and cannot affect N, reward, credit, release count, admission, or authority.

failure_mode_exposed_without_fence: If slot reuse trusted cancellation alone, a late A@g7 terminal could be mistaken for current work and incorrectly increment N, create reward/credit, or double-release R-A1 after B@g1 was admitted.
scope_limit: Constructed role-local controller race only. This does not claim MCTS performance, operating-system cancellation guarantees, production safety, or equivalence to richer execution outside the frozen trace.
